name: Toumei Ningen - Arawaru Arawaru
original_name: 透明人間 あらわるあらわる
source:
Main character is a science teacher with a weak constitution. He was working on a medicine to fortify constitution and accidentally got a substance to grant invisibility. To complete the original medicine he needs to collect women fluids, but as a side mission he's going to have a revenge on those who bullied him in the past.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-june-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名体质虚弱的理科教师。他原本在研制增强体质的药物，却意外制成一种能让人隐形的物质。为了完成最初的药物，他必须收集女性体液；与此同时，他还打算顺便报复过去欺负过自己的人。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-june-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
